sources.title: Form 0509, Notice of Involuntary Transfer — hearing rights and filing instructions
sources.notes: The department's own standard notice form, named by OAR 411-088-0070(4) (source 2) as the form that must be used for a Notice of Transfer. The rule text captured as source 3 names an office and a filing period without a street address; this form supplies both -- a street address, email and fax for the Nursing Facility Licensing Unit -- and states the filing period as calendar days where OAR 411-088-0080 states it as business days, a discrepancy this recipe does not resolve. Slice runs from the 'Your Hearing Rights' heading to the end of the document.
